title: ImUi Color Edit Alpha Preview v1
problem: Make editor ColorEdit swatches visibly communicate non-opaque alpha by adding a checkerboard-backed preview, matching Dear ImGui's transparent ColorButton preview posture without widening the control into a full HSV/RGB picker.

repro.summary: ColorEdit preview swatches and preset swatches render through a shared checkerboard-backed color preview stack, with a unit gate for the checker colors and a policy gate preventing regression to a stub popup.

gates.name: color edit alpha preview
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui alpha_checkerboard_colors_are_stable_and_alternating color_edit_popup_is_a_real_preset_palette_not_a_stub color_presets_are_unique_and_hex_formattable rgb_hex_parse_preserves_alpha_when_alpha_is_not_explicit rgba_hex_parse_is_only_available_when_alpha_is_visible rgb_presets_preserve_current_alpha --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This alpha-preview slice is closed. The AlphaBar follow-on is tracked by imui-color-edit-alpha-bar-v1; start separate follow-ons for HSV/RGB picker depth, color history, eyedropper integration, or color drag/drop payloads.
